headline: redblackbst jumps from 1,553rd to 81st on ARC-2

sections.text: redblackbst gained 9.03 to reach 38.75, climbing from 1,553rd to 81st on the ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard in the past day. The gain carries the team into the top 100.
